name: Park Hyatt Toronto
positioning: Luxury hotel in Yorkville at Bloor Street and Avenue Road, reopened in 2021 after a four-year renovation, with a 17th-floor rooftop bar and Stillwater Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Yorkville base near the Royal Ontario Museum and Bloor Street shopping
Guests who value a spa, a rooftop cocktail bar and seasonal fine dining under one roof

facts.text: Park Hyatt Toronto is in Yorkville, central to Bloor Street and Avenue Road.
The hotel is a short walk from the University of Toronto and Queen's Park.
Chanel, Holt Renfrew and the Royal Ontario Museum are within a stone's throw of the hotel.
The nearest TTC subway station is Museum.
Joni Restaurant is guided by Executive Chef Jonathan Williams and uses locally sourced, sustainable ingredients prepared in-house.
Joni offers a five-course dinner tasting menu with optional Ontario wine pairings.
Afternoon tea at Writers Room includes house-made bites and loose-leaf Sloane Tea selections.
Stillwater Spa has a sauna and steam room.
Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities and a Nespresso coffee maker.
Standard king rooms feature brushed walnut hardwood floors and a walk-in rain shower.
The hotel is dog-friendly, and dogs get their own bed and water bowl on arrival.
The brutalist porte cochere ceiling is lined with tiny lights that look like an overhead starscape.

highlights.text: Writers Room Bar, on the 17th floor, is a rooftop cocktail lounge celebrating the literary voices behind its 50-year story, with views over Queen's Park and the city skyline.
The hotel offers a complimentary house car service within a two-mile radius.
The hotel stewards a permanent art collection inspired by the property's past.
Stillwater Spa has treatment rooms, two couples' suites, and manicure and pedicure services.
The hotel reopened in 2021 after a four-year renovation that added a residential south tower.

considerations.text: Writers Room Bar is for guests 19 and older.
Overnight valet parking is charged; it includes in/out privileges.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
